narrative.details:
Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?

That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.

I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.
narrative.objectives: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
narrative.offerRewardText: You brought me murloc eyes! I am so excited for my first REAL potion I can't breathe!I snuck out and grabbed a few more herbs while you were away and found some empty vials downstairs. Um... you can do the mixing this time.<The child watches enthusiastically you mix the ingredients, but her nose crumples as you add the eyes. The concoction takes on a sickly orange in mere seconds.>Wow! See, I was right. I wouldn't drink that, but here's my recipe if you wanted to make more. Come back sometime!
narrative.requestItemsText: Don't worry about me, I'm a big girl. I can take care of myself. Just don't tell anyone I am hiding here, it's our little secret.
